paragraphs: The stock price of Fermi Inc. is 6.4, with a change of -3.03% compared to the prior close and 2.4% over a window of 23 sessions. The price is as of August 14, 2026.

There are 2 new news items in the last 24 hours, both related to Fermi receiving a US subpoena tied to Project Matador, a data center campus it is developing in west Texas, according to Bloomberg and Bloomberg.com. The subpoena is for certain documents related to the project.

Fermi has filed several recent SEC filings, including a 10-Q form reporting a net loss for the second quarter of 2026, and an 8-K form announcing the appointment of Lee McIntire as its new Chief Executive Officer, effective August 11, 2026, with a disclosed annualized base salary. There is also 1 Form 4 filing in the feed.
